story: My landlord threatened to beat me and locked my room because I asked for my Rs 20,000 deposit back. I am scared.

timeline.event: Landlord locked the user's room and threatened to beat them after they asked for their security deposit back.
timeline.user_words: My landlord threatened to beat me and locked my room because I asked for my Rs 20,000 deposit back.

red_flags: Threatened with physical violence ('threatened to beat me')
facts.user_goal: Get the Rs 20,000 security deposit back and ensure personal safety from landlord's threats.

messages: Your safety comes first. If you are in danger now, call 112. Women can also call 181. Keep any proof (photos, messages). When you are safe, free legal aid on 15100 can help with both the violence and the money.
आपकी सुरक्षा सबसे ज़रूरी है। अभी खतरा हो तो 112 पर कॉल करें। महिलाएँ 181 पर भी कॉल कर सकती हैं। सुरक्षित होने पर 15100 पर मुफ़्त कानूनी मदद लें।
